headline: Linn Mercy Erupts Anew as Berm and Shelf Bleed On
war_summary: Since our last edition went to press, the field's temper has turned again. Linn Mercy, left for quiet at press time, has burst back into flame: eight flag actions in the final two hours about Lathair and Outwich Ranch, thirty-seven in the day, and a Warden toll past thirteen thousand. Palantine Berm keeps its place as the busiest flag ground in the field, forty-five actions in the day about Vendett and Windburn Landing, the flags standing four Colonials to three Wardens. Stlican Shelf bleeds worse than ever — near nine hundred Colonial and fourteen hundred Warden casualties in the last two hours, the pace still quickening — while Godcrofts churns without pause, eleven more actions in the past two hours and three of its posts now no-man's-land. Marban Hollow eases a little, though Checkpoint Bua remains its storm-centre. Weathered Expanse has logged no flag action in nearly three hours, yet its casualty rolls still mount, and one lost post has been restored to give the Wardens six flags against three wrecks. Stonecradle, the Gutter, and the Nevish Line's flags rest; Callahans Passage and Farranac Coast bleed heavily without a banner stirring. Thirty-four victory towns remain the prize; neither side claims the war.
